01-title.text: SecureVoice AI. Real-time voice fraud intervention for banking and insurance. Deployed, live, and audited end to end.

02-gap.text: A bank's fraud engine flags a case. An analyst takes nine minutes to see it, and thirty-eight to work it. The fraudster moves in seconds.

03-ingest.text: A signed risk signal arrives. The platform verifies the signature, resolves the customer, and opens a case, under a second. The call category then selects the agent's prompt, its powers, and the preconditions enforced before a single dial.

04-call.text: The platform places an outbound call. The agent opens with a disclosure, verifies the transaction, and stages a protective action. It never asks for a PIN, an OTP, or a password.

05-guardrails.text: The controls live in the server, not in the prompt. A freeze is only ever staged, and a human finalises it. Pre-production cannot reach a real customer.

06-live.text: Everything you have just seen is running. Captured live from securevoiceai.me.

07-evidence.text: Two legs are measured. Five hundred fifty-one milliseconds from signal to call placement, and nine milliseconds for a tool round-trip. The sixty-second claim is still a target.

08-close.text: Sixty seconds, with the proof attached. SecureVoice AI.
